title: elsholtzia communis
intro: Elsholtzia communis, commonly known as Vietnamese mint or Thai balm, is a type of aromatic perennial herb that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting relaxation, which are attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, including borneol, camphor, and borneol acetate. Regular consumption of Elsholtzia communis is believed to provide relief from symptoms associated with colds, coughs, and sore throats, making it a popular natural remedy in many cultures.
